universe.description: Population scope: 'live' = bonds still in circulation, 'all' = including matured or redeemed. Required; scope is not expressible as a filter.
universe.title: Universe

dimensions.description: 0-3 grouping dimensions. Omit or empty means one grand-total row.

money.description: {target_currency: 'VND'} to normalize a native-currency measure to VND, reproducing the *_vnd measure's own figure.

time.description: {axis: issue_date|maturity_date, grain: month|quarter|year} grouping, equivalent to the issue_*/maturity_* bucket dimensions.

ranking.description: {by, top_n, partition_by} bounded top-N selection after aggregation. Mutually exclusive with sort.
